skill.description: Extract design tokens and UX documentation from an existing project codebase.

skill.author: cubha

security_audit.summary: Most static external-command findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks and code fences. The skill does instruct agents to run repository verification commands during the optional deep cleanup workflow; those commands can execute project-controlled code and should be explicitly reviewed and approved. No prompt injection, obfuscation, credential access, network activity, or data-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Repository verification commands can execute project-controlled scripts.
remediation.suggestion: Before running verify.sh or npm scripts, show the exact command, identify its source, and require explicit user approval. Prefer the least-privileged validation command available.

static_findings.snippet: **존재 이유**: 이미 개발된 프로젝트에서 **기존 코드를 Ground Truth로 확정**하고 `docs/design/` 기준 파일을 역추출로 생성하는 전용 스킬이다. 디자인
| 코드 변경 | 스타일 전면 교체 | 기본 없음 (`--deep` 시 한정적) |
| `--deep` | OFF | 하드코딩 교체 + 유틸 클래스 추출 + 컴포넌트 정리 |
| `--dry-run` | OFF | GENERATE 직전까지만 — 토큰 미리보기 출력, 파일 생성 없음 |
| `docs/design/DESIGN-TOKENS.md` 존재 | 사용자에게 경고: "이미 파일이 존재합니다. 덮어쓰면 기존 파일은 archive로 이동됩니다. 계속할까요?" →
| CSS 전역 파일 | `**/globals.css`, `**/index.css`, `**/*.module.css` | CSS 커스텀 프로퍼티 (`:root`, `[data-th
| 프로젝트 문서 | 프로젝트 루트 (`CLAUDE.md`, `README.md`, `package.json`) | 기술 스택, 구조 원칙 |
| 1 | CSS `:root` / `[data-theme]` 커스텀 프로퍼티 | 높음 — 이미 토큰화된 값 |
| 3 | globals.css 커스텀 유틸 클래스 (`.btn`, `.sv-label` 등) | 중간 — 프로젝트 전용 클래스 |
| 4 | 컴포넌트 `className` 반복 패턴 | 중간 — 암묵적 토큰 |
**Color**: 배경(`bg`), 전경(`fg`), 강조(`accent`), 테두리(`border`), 음소거(`muted`), 코드 배경 등. 다크/라이트 모드 분리.
**커스텀 유틸 클래스**: 프로젝트 전용 클래스 (예: `.sv-label`, `.h-1`, `.btn-primary`, `.metallic`). 역할과 적용 컨텍스트를 함께 기
| 시맨틱 역할 분류 | 값 → 역할 이름 매핑 (`--bg-base`, `--fg-primary`, `--accent`, `--border-default` 등) |
`--dry-run` 시 이 단계에서 미리보기만 출력하고 종료한다.
기존 `DESIGN-TOKENS.md` / `UX-BRIEF.md` 존재 시 → `docs/design/archive/{YYYY-MM-DD}/`로 이동 후 생성.
`--deep` 미지정 시 이 단계를 완전히 건너뛴다.
`--deep`은 GENERATE 완료 후 실행된다. 코드 변경이 수반되므로 **각 단계 전 사용자 승인**을 받는다.
승인 후 `replace_all`로 일괄 처리. 이후 프로젝트 검증(아래 5-3 참조) — FAIL 시 해당 파일만 롤백.
3개 이상 컴포넌트에서 동일한 Tailwind 클래스 조합이 반복되는 경우 `globals.css`에 커스텀 유틸 클래스로 추출을 제안한다.
모든 `--deep` 정리 완료 후 최종 검증한다. 프로젝트에 검증 스크립트가 있으면 실행한다 (`verify.sh`, `npm test`, `npm run build`, `npm
- **`--deep`은 코드 변경 수반**: 각 단계 전 사용자 승인 필수. 승인 없이 자동 치환하지 않는다.
- **검증 기반 롤백**: `--deep` 실행 중 프로젝트 검증(verify.sh·`npm run build` 등) FAIL 시 해당 배치만 롤백하고 계속 진행한다.

content.value_statement: Existing projects often lack a clear record of their interface decisions. This skill extracts design tokens and current UX structure into practical documentation for future UI work.
actual_capabilities: Scans CSS files, Tailwind configuration, layout components, and page files for design evidence.
Extracts colors, typography, spacing, radius, shadows, motion values, and reusable utility classes.
Normalizes similar values into semantic design-token categories.
Creates DESIGN-TOKENS.md as a reference for the existing interface.
Creates UX-BRIEF.md with observed routes and layout structure.
Offers an optional deep cleanup workflow with approval before code changes.
limitations: It documents the current implementation and does not create a new product design.
Token quality depends on the CSS, components, and configuration available in the selected path.
It cannot infer product intent that is not represented in source code.
Deep cleanup can change source files and requires review and explicit approval.

use_cases.title: Prepare an undocumented product for UI work
use_cases.description: Create a design-token reference before adding screens to an existing application.

use_cases.title: Map a legacy interface
use_cases.description: Record visual patterns and route structure before modernizing a mature codebase.

use_cases.title: Create a team design reference
use_cases.description: Generate project-specific documentation that helps contributors use established styles consistently.

prompt_templates.title: Create design documentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Run init-design for this project and create the design token and UX brief files.

prompt_templates.title: Preview extracted tokens
prompt_templates.prompt: Run init-design on src/ with --dry-run. Show the extracted tokens before creating files.

prompt_templates.title: Document a selected application area
prompt_templates.prompt: Run init-design for src/features/dashboard. Create documentation only for this area.

prompt_templates.title: Review cleanup candidates
prompt_templates.prompt: Run init-design with --deep. Show every proposed change and wait for my approval before editing files.

output_examples.input: Run a dry run for the application source.
output: A scan summary of CSS variables, Tailwind extensions, utility classes, inline styles, and routes.
A normalized preview of color, typography, spacing, and motion tokens.

output_examples.input: Create the design documentation for this repository.
output: A DESIGN-TOKENS.md file with observed visual values and reusable classes.
A UX-BRIEF.md file with the observed route map and layout structure.
Existing documentation is archived only after user approval.

best_practices: Run a dry run first and review the extracted values before creating documentation.
Use the generated files as references, then verify important tokens against the rendered interface.
Approve each deep cleanup step only after reviewing the proposed file changes.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the output as a replacement for a new product design or accessibility review.
Do not run deep cleanup without reviewing the proposed replacements.
Do not overwrite existing design documents without confirming the archive action.

faq.question: Does this skill redesign my interface?
faq.answer: No. It documents the interface already implemented in the selected codebase.

faq.question: What files does it create?
faq.answer: It creates DESIGN-TOKENS.md and, unless skipped, UX-BRIEF.md under docs/design.

faq.question: Can I preview results before files are created?
faq.answer: Yes. Use --dry-run to scan and preview normalized tokens without generating files.

faq.question: What does --deep do?
faq.answer: It proposes approved cleanup changes, such as replacing mapped hardcoded values and extracting repeated utility patterns.

faq.question: Will existing design documents be lost?
faq.answer: No. The skill asks for approval and archives existing files before replacing them.

faq.question: Does it support Tailwind CSS?
faq.answer: Yes. It inspects Tailwind configuration and repeated utility-class patterns when they are present.
